clips.title: The story
paras: At Ironband's Excavation Site, Prospector Ironband directs a dig into Khaz Modan's buried past. He leads the Dwarven Explorers' Guild's work in southeastern Loch Modan, seeking the heritage of the dwarven people and sending reports and relics to Ironforge despite setbacks and hostile creatures.

Prospector Ironband leads the dig at Ironband's Excavation Site in the hills of southeastern Loch Modan. Like other field researchers in the Explorers' Guild, he believes Khaz Modan's soil holds truths about the origins of the dwarven race. His camp digs trenches and sifts rubble for ancient relics, stone tablets, and earthen artifacts. The work moves slowly, but Ironband remains resolute and welcomes capable travelers who can safeguard the operation.

Local troggs and wildlife threaten the excavation in Loch Modan's rugged wilds. They put the dig's supply lines and equipment at risk, and relics and survey tools may be stolen or wrecked before the Guild can examine them. Ironband relies on visiting Alliance travelers to guard cargo shipments, hold off raiders, and look into missing Guild contacts in the neighboring badlands.
